lines.en: label bathhouse35p1:
scene iosenseifaint1
: ...and then Murakami hit a walk-off missile to the opposite field that smacked some old lady right in the face! It was totally crazy! You had to see it!
lines.zh: : ……然后 Murakami 击出一发再见全垒打，直飞反向外野，正好砸在某个老太太的脸上！简直疯了！你真该看看！

lines.en: : Io, I don’t like baseball.
lines.zh: : Io，我不喜欢棒球。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. But I do, so you should at least try to be interested. Like I do when you talk about other girls around me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。可我喜欢，所以你至少该试着感兴趣。就像你在我面前聊别的女孩时，我也试着感兴趣一样。

lines.en: : But you never try to be interested when I talk about other girls.
lines.zh: : 可你从来没试着感兴趣过啊，我聊别的女孩的时候。

lines.en: : Sure I do! I just fail immediately.
lines.zh: : 我有！我只是马上就失败了。

lines.en: As you can see, I’ve decided to spend the afternoon at the bathhouse...and by afternoon I mean “night” because the day has kind of just slipped away from me at this point.
lines.zh: 如你所见，我决定在澡堂消磨这个下午……说下午，其实就是「夜里」，因为这一天到这会儿已经从我指缝里溜走了。

lines.en: But hey, I’ve apparently got decently high tolerance when it comes to hot water and don’t feel anywhere even close to passing out just yet despite being in here for-
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我对热水的耐受度显然相当高，在这儿待了——嗯，还完全没觉得要晕过去。

lines.en: : Io, how long have I been in here for?
lines.zh: : Io，我在这儿待了多久了？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint2
: Mmm......six hours. But you don’t have to rush to get out. The more time I get to spend with you, the better.
lines.zh: : 嗯......六个小时。不过你不急着出来。能跟你多待一会儿，我就更高兴了。

lines.en: Strike that. I apparently have {i}very{/i} high tolerance when it comes to hot water. But I make up for that in being utterly horrible when it comes to time management.
lines.zh: 收回刚才那句。我对热水的耐受度显然「{i}非常{/i}」高。不过在时间管理上烂得彻底，算是扯平了。

lines.en: Either way, we wind up in the same position we’ve found ourselves in time and time before — with me facing one direction while Io faces the other.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们又回到了那个重复过无数次的局面——我朝一边，Io 朝另一边。

lines.en: I’m not quite sure what makes her immune to the allure of my penis (Especially given just how much she’s seen of it), but I’m pretty confident it’s only a matter of time now until she winds up in the bath with me.
lines.zh: 我不太确定她为什么能对我的阴茎免疫（尤其是她已经看得那么多了），但我相当有信心，她迟早会跟我一起下到池子里来。

lines.en: And I’m dead set on spending another six hours in here if that brings me any closer to whatever rhetorical tipping point is needed to make that happen.
lines.zh: 而且我打定主意，如果再泡六个小时能让我更接近那个让这事发生的临界点，我就再泡六个小时。

lines.en: : Is it really okay if you just spend all of your time with me instead of watching the front desk?
lines.zh: : 你把时间都花在我这儿、不去看着前台，真的没关系吗？

lines.en: Or at least I {i}tell{/i} myself I’m dead set on that while my mouth attempts to betray me in coaxing her away.
lines.zh: 至少我嘴上「{i}告诉{/i}」自己打定主意了，而我的嘴却在试图背叛我，把她劝走。

lines.en: But on the bright side, at least one segment of my being isn’t morally inept tonight.
lines.zh: 不过往好处想，今晚我身上至少有一部分在道德上还没烂透。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I put a sign thingy up. And it’s not like I’ve been {i}completely{/i} neglecting my post. I’m still going out there to check on stuff every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我挂了个牌子。而且我也没有「{i}完全{/i}」放着岗位不管。我还是会时不时出去看看。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint3
: In fact, it’s probably better for business if I stay on the men’s side and make sure all of our male customers don’t go peeping on the women.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我待在男汤这边、确保男客人们不会去偷看女的，对生意可能更好。

lines.en: : I am the only male customer you ever have.
lines.zh: : 我可是你唯一的男客人。

lines.en: : And are you saying you {i}wouldn’t{/i} try and look through the fence if I wasn’t around?
lines.zh: : 那你是说，如果我不在，你就{i}不会{/i}试着从围栏缝里看？

lines.en: : Fair point.
lines.zh: : 说得对。

lines.en: : It would be nice to have {i}something{/i} to look at while I’m in here, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我在里面的时候，能有点{i}什么{/i}可看就好了。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint4
: Want me to go get your phone? There’s a level of damage-risk involved since you’re in the bath and whatnot, but I do it all the time and I’ve only lost, like...one phone because of it.
lines.zh: : 要我帮你去拿手机吗？你在池子里，是有一定损坏风险的，不过我经常这么干，也因此只丢过，大概……一个手机吧。

lines.en: : I was suggesting something a bit more impure if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 我指的是更不纯洁一点的东西，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint5
: Hey, it’s not my business what you look at on your phone. I was just trying to be of some help since I {i}am{/i} technically on the clock right now.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你在手机上看什么不关我的事。我只是想帮点忙，毕竟我现在{i}技术上{/i}还在上班。

lines.en: : What about when you’re off the clock?
lines.zh: : 那你下班之后呢？

lines.en: Somehow or another, I manage to remind my mouth of who we really are as the last, flimsy barrier between my good side and bad side is ripped to shreds.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我成功让我的嘴记起了我们到底是什么东西——在我善的一面和恶的一面之间最后那道脆弱的屏障被撕成碎片的时候。

lines.en: : When I’m off the clock, I have to clean everything. Then, I have to eat dinner. {i}Then,{/i} I have to pick up dinner for Uta. {i}Then,{/i} I have to walk all the way back to the dorms.
lines.zh: : 下班之后，我得把所有东西打扫一遍。然后，我得吃晚饭。{i}然后{/i}，我得去给 Uta 拿晚饭。{i}再然后{/i}，我得一路走回宿舍。

lines.en: : As you can see, I’ve got a pretty busy night ahead of me.
lines.zh: : 你看，我今晚挺忙的。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like you could use a little something to relax.
lines.zh: : 我听来，你大概需要点什么来放松一下。

lines.en: : Probably. But I should wait at least another two hours before popping a second Adderall.
lines.zh: : 大概是。不过我至少得再等两个小时才能吃第二颗阿得拉。

lines.en: : If only there was some other way for you to wind down...
lines.zh: : 要是还有别的办法能让你放松就好了……

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint6
: Want me to give you a few minutes alone so you can relieve yourself and stop trying to get me into the bath with you?
lines.zh: : 要我给你几分钟独处时间，让你解决一下、别再想着把我弄进池子里吗？

lines.en: : Also, when I say “relieve yourself” I mean {i}outside{/i} of the bath, please. That stuff’s not good for the drain.
lines.zh: : 还有，我说「解决一下」是指在池子{i}外面{/i}，拜托。那玩意儿对排水管道不好。

lines.en: : That’s probably for the best at this point. It’s a little difficult for me to stop myself once my brain gets locked onto something.
lines.zh: : 事到如今，大概这样最好。一旦我的脑子锁定什么，就很难停下来。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint7

: Testosterone will do that to you. I think. I’m admittedly less knowledgeable about the male anatomy than the female one. But that’s not something I want to get into with you, even if you {i}are{/i} my teacher.
lines.zh: : 睾酮会让你变成那样。我想是吧。老实说，我对男性解剖学的了解比对女性的少。不过这话题我不想跟你聊，哪怕你{i}是{/i}我的老师。

lines.en: : Hold on. I’ll Google it.
lines.zh: : 等等。我谷歌一下。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Yup. Google says, “Sexual desire is typically higher in men than in women, with testosterone (T) thought to account for this difference.” The more you know.
lines.zh: : 嗯。谷歌说：「男性的性欲通常高于女性，一般认为这是睾酮（T）造成的差异。」又学到知识了。

lines.en: : Io, how much longer are you going to do this for?
lines.zh: : Io，你还要这样多久？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint8
: Do what? Google stuff? Because I’m already done. That was it.
lines.zh: : 干什么？谷歌东西？因为我已经查完了。就这些。

lines.en: : You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道我什么意思。

lines.en: : Of course I know what you mean, which is why I’m trying to delicately steer the conversation {i}away{/i} from that subject by both boring and annoying you with science and stats. Is it working?
lines.zh: : 我当然知道你什么意思，所以我才试着用科学和统计数据把你烦死、无聊死，巧妙地把话题从那件事上{i}引开{/i}。有用吗？

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah...
lines.zh: : 有一点吧，嗯……

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint9
: Great! Then you won’t mind if I just zoom right on past all this anatomy stuff and find something else to annoy you about!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那你不会介意我直接跳过这些解剖学的东西，找点别的来烦你了吧！

lines.en: : Ooh, here’s an article about whales. That should kill a few more minutes while we wait for all the women to leave.
lines.zh: : 哦，这儿有篇关于鲸鱼的文章。等所有女客都走了，这应该能再打发几分钟。

lines.en: I’m going to have to get to the bottom of this sooner or later...I’m just not sure {i}how{/i} when every time I try winds up like this.
lines.zh: 我迟早得把这事弄明白……只是每次试探都变成这样，我不知道该{i}怎么{/i}办。

lines.en: And even if Uta has trouble keeping her mouth shut, I know she won’t just go spilling whatever Io’s deal is to me if I ask nicely.
lines.zh: 就算 Uta 管不住自己的嘴，我知道只要我好好问，她也不会把 Io 的情况一股脑倒给我。

lines.en: It’s obviously going to require a little more work...but how exactly can I work {i}toward{/i} it when the tool I’ve used for every other issue thus far is disabled?
lines.zh: 显然这需要多花点功夫……可当我至今用来对付其他所有问题的那个工具已经失效时，我到底该怎么{i}朝{/i}它努力？

lines.en: Sex has been my weapon for almost everything- but some creatures or targets require something a little different.
lines.zh: 性一直是我用来解决几乎一切问题的武器——可有些生物、有些目标，需要的是稍微不同的东西。

lines.en: I don’t want to have to manipulate Io into revealing her secrets to me, especially when I know she’s perceptive enough to pick up on that immediately.
lines.zh: 我不想把 Io 哄到向我吐露秘密，尤其是我知道她足够敏锐，一眼就能看穿。

lines.en: The saddest part of all of it is that this method probably {i}would{/i} work-
lines.zh: 最可悲的是，这办法大概{i}确实{/i}会奏效——

lines.en: And that she’d simply {i}allow{/i} herself to be manipulated because it would make it easier to blame her mental shortcomings on someone else later on.
lines.zh: 而她会就这么「{i}允许{/i}」自己被操纵，因为那样日后更容易把自己的心理缺陷怪到别人头上。

lines.en: I know that to be true because that’s what {i}I{/i} would do. And every day that passes by, she seems more and more similar to me.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}知道这是真的，因为我「自己」就会这么做。而每过一天，她都看起来越来越像我。

lines.en: But no one will ever be an exact replica...so there will always be something to misunderstand or misinterpret.
lines.zh: 可没有人会是完全相同的复制品……所以总会有被误解、被误读的地方。

lines.en: I just hope it won’t last forever.
lines.zh: 我只希望那不会永远持续下去。

lines.en: Because beneath the sentimentality and the desire for her to feel safe whenever she’s with me-
lines.zh: 因为在那份多愁善感、那份想让她在我身边时感到安心的愿望之下——

lines.en: There is an undying urge to shove my cock so deep inside of her that she splits into two pieces.
lines.zh: 有一种不死的冲动：把我的鸡巴捅进她身体最深处，深到把她劈成两半。

lines.en: And an even greater urge to show her that what she wants isn’t what she wants at all.
lines.zh: 还有更大的一种冲动：想让她明白，她想要的根本不是她想要的。

lines.en: : Ooooh, interesting. Sensei, did you know there’s a type of whale that-
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，有意思。Sensei，你知道吗，有一种鲸——

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint10
: Um...hello?...Is anyone there?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你好？……有人在吗？……

lines.en: : That’s not another guy, is it?
lines.zh: : 那不会又是个男的吧？

lines.en: : I hope not. I don’t like sharing.
lines.zh: : 我希望不是。我不喜欢分享。

lines.en: : Oh. No. That's a girl.
lines.zh: : 哦。不。是个女的。

lines.en: : Is she attractive?
lines.zh: : 她好看吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不怎么好看。

lines.en: : Screw it. Let her in anyway.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。让她进来吧。

lines.en: : Hey, you. You’re not allowed over here, you know. This is the men’s bath.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你。你不可以到这边来，知道吗。这是男汤。

lines.en: : Y-Yes! I know, but...the towel rack is empty and...I left mine at home...
lines.zh: : 是、是的！我知道，可是……毛巾架空了，而且……我把我的忘在家里了……

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint11
: Ugh, already? Just how busy are we on the other side tonight?
lines.zh: : 唉，又来？今晚那边到底有多忙啊？

lines.en: : Sensei, I’ll be back in a few minutes. Just gotta refill some stuff.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我几分钟就回来。得去补点东西。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint12
: But remember, no jerking it in the bath.
lines.zh: : 不过记住，不许在池子里打飞机。

lines.en: : It’s bad for the drains, I know.
lines.zh: : 对排水管道不好，我知道。

lines.en: : Atta boy.
scene iosenseifaint13
: Hah...
I close my eyes and try to relax a bit as Io exits the men’s side of the bath.
lines.zh: Io 离开男汤那边，我闭上眼睛，想放松一下。

lines.en: I know I was getting ahead of myself a short while ago, but...I guess I’m just not used to getting the runaround when it comes to romance.
lines.zh: 我知道我刚才有点得意忘形了，可是……我想我只是不习惯在感情上被这么推来推去。

lines.en: If you can even call this romance, that is.
lines.zh: 如果这也能叫感情的话。

lines.en: If anything, it feels more like I’m {i}her{/i} uncle sometimes — what with the minimal sexual attraction and the overall desire to just “hang out” with me.
lines.zh: 要说的话，有时候感觉我更像{i}她{/i}的「叔叔」——性吸引力少得可怜，总体上只想跟我「待着」。

lines.en: But, then again, she has mentioned on many occasions having actual feelings for me and wanting to be my girlfriend...
lines.zh: 可话说回来，她也多次提到过对我有真正的感情、想当我女朋友……

lines.en: All things considered, though...that’s pretty tame compared to my current perception of what unclehood entails.
lines.zh: 不过总的来说……比起我现在对「当叔叔」这件事的理解，那已经相当温和了。

lines.en: I just wish I could bring myself to understand how she can love in such a “hands-off” kind of way.
lines.zh: 我只希望自己能弄明白，她怎么能以这样一种「不动手」的方式去爱。

lines.en: For me, that’s not what love is like at all.
lines.zh: 对我来说，爱根本不是那样的。

lines.en: For me, love is something much more primitive.
lines.zh: 对我来说，爱是某种更原始的东西。

lines.en: And while that may be just me poorly defining one more word that’s meant to be interpreted in a different way, I-
lines.zh: 虽然那可能又是我把一个本该有别的解读的词定义得很糟糕，我——

lines.en: I-
scene iosenseifaint14
scene iosenseifaint15
: Aaahh...
lines.zh: : 啊啊……

lines.en: : There’s nothing quite like a hot bath after a long day of being dead.
lines.zh: : 当了一整天「死人」之后，没什么比泡个热水澡更舒服的了。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint16
: Oh, hey.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。

lines.en: : Come here often?
lines.zh: : 常来吗？

lines.en: scene black
scene iosenseifaint17
: Ah...You’re finally awake.
lines.zh: : 啊……你终于醒了。

lines.en: : Where am I?...
lines.zh: : 我在哪儿？……

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint18
: My room.
lines.zh: : 我的房间。

lines.en: : You passed out in the bath...which, in hindsight, is probably my fault after letting you stay in there for over six hours. So yeah, I’ll take the hit for this one.
lines.zh: : 你在池子里晕过去了……现在想想，让你在里面待了六个多小时，大概是我的错。所以这锅我背。

lines.en: : Do you...need anything? Water? Tea? Maybe like, a...sandwich or something?
lines.zh: : 你……需要什么吗？水？茶？或者，那个……三明治什么的？

lines.en: : If there’s something specific you’re craving, it means your body’s probably low on some kind of nutrient or something. And there’s plenty of stuff downstairs I could grab for you.
lines.zh: : 如果你特别想吃某种东西，说明你身体大概缺了某种营养什么的。楼下有很多东西我可以给你拿。

lines.en: : How long have I been out?
lines.zh: : 我晕了多久？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint19

: Not long. Maybe only twenty minutes or so. But I was somehow able to drag you up here all by myself, which I should definitely be praised for. Just...when you’re a little more conscious. I can wait until then.
lines.zh: : 不久。大概也就二十分钟。不过我居然能一个人把你拖上来，这件事绝对该被表扬。只不过……等你再清醒一点好了。我可以等到那时候。

lines.en: I stare up at an unfamiliar ceiling, but instead of wondering what transpired between when I passed out and now, I get stuck guessing how many more times I’ll wake up here.
lines.zh: 我仰头盯着一个陌生的天花板，可我没有去想昏迷到现在之间发生了什么，而是卡在猜测自己还有多少次会在这里醒来。

lines.en: One if I’m lucky.
lines.zh: 运气好的话一次。

lines.en: Two if Io is an idiot.
lines.zh: 如果 Io 是个笨蛋，两次。

lines.en: Three or more if there’s anything to this connection other than “obnoxious girl” and “the guy she latched onto.”
lines.zh: 如果我们之间除了「烦人女孩」和「被她缠上的男人」以外还有点什么，三次或更多。

lines.en: The room smells like her — a mix of blueberries and wood polish. It’s just as cluttered as her dorm and it appears as though it hasn’t been dusted or cleaned in over a year.
lines.zh: 房间里有她的味道——蓝莓和家具蜡的混合。和她宿舍一样乱，看起来至少有一年没打扫、没擦过灰了。

lines.en: She probably doesn’t spend much time in here. And if I didn’t know her as well as I do, I might even mistake it for some sort of storage room.
lines.zh: 她大概不常待在这儿。要是我不是这么了解她，我甚至会误以为这是某间储藏室。

lines.en: But, with that being said...it’s far more comfortable than it has any right to be.
lines.zh: 可话说回来……它舒服得过分了。

lines.en: And I’m not quite sure if I’m just saying that because I’m waking up in a daze.
lines.zh: 我不太确定自己是不是因为刚从迷糊中醒来才这么觉得。

lines.en: I stare at the ceiling again.
lines.zh: 我又盯着天花板看。

lines.en: There’s a tennis ball grip on the pull-chain of a fan.
lines.zh: 风扇的拉链上套着一个网球握把。

lines.en: The word “Io” is written on it.
lines.zh: 上面写着「Io」。

lines.en: And this one small glimpse of one small speck of her childhood makes me sick to my stomach for the things I was thinking just a short while ago.
lines.zh: 而这一小瞥、她童年的一小点碎片，让我为刚才那些想法恶心到想吐。

lines.en: I’d give anything to not desire fruit before it’s at its ripest — and I curse this body’s need for the sourest of sweets.
lines.zh: 我愿意付出一切，去换取不对尚未成熟的水果产生欲望——我诅咒这具身体对最酸涩的甜味的渴求。

lines.en: : So...tea? Water? What’s it gonna be?
lines.zh: : 那么……茶？水？你要哪个？

lines.en: : You really carried me all the way up here by yourself?
lines.zh: : 你真是一个人把我拖上来的？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint20
: I’m stronger than I look, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我比看起来要强壮，Sensei。

lines.en: : Though, I will reiterate that it was more like {i}dragging{/i} you than carrying you. And if you feel sore tomorrow morning, blame the stairs, not me.
lines.zh: : 不过我重申一下，与其说是「背」你，不如说是{i}拖{/i}你。要是你明天早上觉得酸痛，怪楼梯，别怪我。

lines.en: : Thank you, Io. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Io。真的很感谢。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint21
: It’s nothing. Like I said, it’s probably my fault in the first place.
lines.zh: : 没什么。就像我说的，一开始大概就是我的错。

lines.en: : Oh, and I couldn’t get your pants back on without getting a little too {i}handsy,{/i} so I hope you don’t mind what I dressed you up in instead.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，我没法在不{i}动手动脚{/i}的情况下给你把裤子穿回去，所以希望你别介意我给你换了这一身。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint22
: What have you done to me?
lines.zh: : 你对我做了什么？

lines.en: : What? I think you look kinda cute in this. It’s a side of you I’m sure that only {i}I’ve{/i} gotten to see, and that makes me really happy.
lines.zh: : 什么？我觉得你穿这个挺可爱的。这可是我敢肯定只有「{i}我{/i}」见过的你的一面，这让我特别开心。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint23
: Why do you even {i}own{/i} something like this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会{i}有{/i}这种东西？

lines.en: : It’s my aunt’s, obviously. She’s not really known for her sense of fashion. And {i}I’m{/i} not really known for wearing flashy colors or leopard print.
lines.zh: : 显然是我阿姨的。她的时尚品味可不出名。而「{i}我{/i}」也不是那种穿鲜艳颜色或豹纹的人。

lines.en: : Neither am I. Where are my normal clothes?
lines.zh: : 我也不是。我的正常衣服呢？

lines.en: : Folded near the door. But you don’t need to worry about getting changed right now. Let me take care of you a little bit longer. Just until you’re ready to go home.
lines.zh: : 折好放在门边。不过你现在不必急着换。让我再多照顾你一会儿，直到你准备好回家。

lines.en: : Heck, you don’t even have to go home today if you don’t want. My aunt’s away for the whole weekend and I’ve got the place to myself.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你今天不想回家也行。我阿姨整个周末都不在，这地方就我一个人。

lines.en: : And you’re sure this is okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定这样没关系？

lines.en: : Of course. If I’m gonna treat anybody to the ultimate Io special at no charge at all, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 当然。如果要免费请谁享受终极 Io 特惠，那就是你了。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint24
: Wow, you must {i}really{/i} be out of it. I basically just handed you the perfect opportunity for another perverted joke and you completely squandered-
lines.zh: : 哇，你{i}真的{/i}还没清醒。我基本上把一个完美的下流笑话机会递到你手上了，你居然完全浪费——

lines.en: : I’m sorry for saying all that stuff to you earlier, Io.
lines.zh: : Io，我为我之前对你说的那些话道歉。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint25
: I know it makes you uncomfortable, but I keep doing it anyway.
lines.zh: : 我知道那让你不舒服，可我还是一直在说。

lines.en: : You don’t deserve that.
lines.zh: : 你不该被那样对待。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint26
: Even...
lines.zh: : 就算……

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} that’s true, it’s not something you need to apologize for.
lines.zh: : 就算那是真的，你也不必为此道歉。

lines.en: : There’s no reason you should have to change the way you are just because {i}I’ve{/i} got issues. That’s not fair to anybody.
lines.zh: : 没有理由因为「{i}我{/i}」有问题，就让你改变自己的样子。这对任何人都不公平。

lines.en: : What’s not fair is that you have to go so far out of your way for me for things like this, but I never do {i}anything{/i} for you.
lines.zh: : 不公平的是，你为我做到这种地步，而我却从来没为你做过{i}任何{/i}事。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint27
: Now, that’s not true at all.
lines.zh: : 这话可完全不对。

lines.en: : You brought me into your class when I wasn’t happy in my last one.
lines.zh: : 我在原来的班上不开心的时候，是你把我带进了你的班。

lines.en: : You let me bother you all the time even though I know it annoys you and you’ve miraculously not asked me to stop talking to you yet.
lines.zh: : 你让我一天到晚烦你，尽管我知道那很烦人，而你奇迹般地到现在都没让我闭嘴。

lines.en: : You even chased me out of the bathhouse when I got upset about my trashy toy and held my hand in the park.
lines.zh: : 我还因为那个破玩具难过、从澡堂跑出去的时候，是你追了出来，还在公园里牵了我的手。

lines.en: : I’m not the only one who does stuff for you, Sensei. In fact, this is {i}nothing{/i} compared to everything you’ve done for me and-
lines.zh: : Sensei，不是只有你在为我做事。事实上，跟你为我做的一切相比，这{i}根本不算什么{/i}，而且——

lines.en: : And what?
lines.zh: : 而且什么？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint28
: Pfft!
: ...And {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : ……而且{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Hahaha! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I can’t do it! I tried, but I just can’t! It’s not possible to have a serious conversation with you while you’re dressed like that! Hahah! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！我做不到！我试了，可就是做不到！你穿成那样，我没办法跟你正经说话！哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint29
: Okay, okay. Let me try this-
lines.zh: : 好，好。让我再试试——

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint30
: Hahahaha! Ahahaha! Hahah! Ahh! Oh god! I can’t do it! I can’t!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！啊哈哈哈！哈哈！啊！哦天啊！我做不到！我不行！

lines.en: : You said my clothes are near the door?
lines.zh: : 你说我的衣服在门边？

lines.en: scene black
: Hahah! Hahah...{i}ahh...{/i}Yeah...Hahaha...If you want to keep talking, go ahead and put them on.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！哈哈……{i}啊……{/i}对……哈哈哈……要是你想继续聊，就去穿上吧。

lines.en: : Either that or I can keep them as a keepsake of yours and you can keep my aunt’s clothes as a keepsake of- oh. The pants are already off.
lines.zh: : 要么我就把它们当你的纪念品留着，你把我阿姨的衣服当我的纪念品留着——哦。裤子已经脱了。

lines.en: : This is not a memory I want to treasure and I’d prefer if we never talked about this-
lines.zh: : 这可不是我想珍藏的回忆，我希望我们永远别再提这件事——

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint31
: Io! I came as quickly as I could! Is Sensei really-
lines.zh: : Io！我尽快赶来了！Sensei 真的——

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint32
: Hey, Uta. He’s awake now. You don’t have to worry anymore.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Uta。他醒了。你不用担心了。

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint33
: Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: scene iosenseifaint34
: Welp. Uta's dead now.
lines.zh: : 唉。Uta 现在死了。

lines.en: : That was quick.
lines.zh: : 真快。

lines.en: : Rest in peace...my dearest friend.
lines.zh: : 安息吧……我最亲爱的朋友。

lines.en: scene black
$ bathhouse35p1 = True
$ io_love += 1
jump bathhouse35p2
